title: One small fix
summary: Plan and do one safe, respectful improvement in a shared space.
objectives: Choose a tiny action that helps shared space
Reflect on impact without hero talk
briefMarkdown:
## Mission

Pick **one** small fix you can do safely this week:
- Pick up litter with gloves if needed
- Refill a handwash bottle at home/school if allowed
- Make a polite reminder sign (no insults)
- Help organise a 10-minute clean with friends

Get permission when required. Stay safe.

quiz.prompt: Which is the best "small fix" principle?

options.label: Do something dramatic once and disappear
Choose a safe action you can finish and that others can maintain
Break a rule because the cause is good

quiz.teachBack: Sustainable civic care is safe, finishable, and respectful.

projectPrompt: What will you do, when, and how will you know it helped?

supported.coachNote: Offer 3 safe action menus to pick from.

steady.coachNote: Ask about permission and safety gear.

fast.coachNote: Ask how to invite one peer without nagging.

llm.tutorBrief: Keep actions legal and safe. No vigilante behaviour. Celebrate small consistent care.
